craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 16. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 2. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Through rite, instrument, place, maṇḍala, form, mantra; through meditation, union, sole devotion, knowledge, identification — (these are the causes of presence).
